name: platinum-blonde-bath-bombshell
image_purpose: beauty editorial and vintage fashion campaign portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a vintage 1960s-inspired glamour bathroom portrait with a playful editorial mood.
prompt.main_subject: An adult fictional woman with platinum-white blonde hair set in large black rollers, light blue-green eyes, natural makeup with nude-pink lips, and a relaxed direct gaze. She reclines in a white bathtub filled with opaque bubbles, with shoulders and arms visible above the foam, wearing a silver cross pendant choker, gold rings, and a gold chain bracelet. She holds an unlit cigarette near her lips as a retro prop.

prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm soft diffused studio or bathroom lighting flattering realistic skin and foam, old-Hollywood glamour with playful vintage editorial atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Professional fashion-photography look, overhead framing, realistic water droplets, soap suds, hair rollers, tile, and jewelry detail, natural anatomy, no text or logos.
